_readme: Ratcheted by scripts/coverage-ratchet.mjs. modulesObserved may only rise; modulesWithZeroCoverage may only fall. To move a number the wrong way, edit it here in the same commit and add a line to justifications saying why.
_note: modulesWithZeroCoverage was 152 in the first baseline. It is 98 here not because tests were added but because the ratchet stopped counting type-only modules, which TypeScript erases and V8 therefore cannot instrument. 75 reachable modules are type-only. The earlier 152 was an over-count.

lineCoverageRecordOnly.note: NOT gated — nondeterministic, see the docblock in scripts/coverage-ratchet.mjs
